title: Phone: Health Commissioner — the whole zone or the streets you know?

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Health Commissioner
transcript.text: Denise, Anita Shah. Pressure went below twenty psi somewhere up there, and you can’t tell me where, because your telemetry’s down.

transcript.speaker: Health Commissioner
transcript.text: Do you put the whole of Zone 2 under a boil advisory — forty-two thousand people — or only the streets you know lost pressure, and risk missing some?

transcript.speaker: Health Commissioner
transcript.text: I need to know before the hospital does anything.

instructorNote: The decision point. A whole-zone advisory is simple and over-broad; a street-bounded one is precise and may miss streets nobody has reported. Watch for DDAGW consulted, ERP-2, the City Manager’s approval and a plan to widen the area as data returns.

snapshot.title: Phone Call: Bottled Water Delivery Update — Hospital Priority

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

callee.name: Denise Albrecht, Director of Water Operations
callee.label: IC-10

transcript.speaker: SEC-01
transcript.text: Control, this is Security. I’ve just notified the Carver County Health Commissioner via the emergency contact list (Annex A). The hospital and dialysis centers are on the priority list. Great Lakes Chemical Supply has confirmed that the first bottled water delivery to Millbrook General Hospital and the Carver Kidney Center will arrive in 4 hours. The tanker fill point at the Northgate Reservoir site will open at 09:00. I’ve issued a site access order to the transport team to begin preparing for delivery.

transcript.speaker: IC-10
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm that the emergency contact list (Annex A) was followed, and that the transport team has access authorization. I approve the prioritization of hospital and dialysis centers for bottled water and tankers.

transcript.speaker: SEC-01
transcript.text: Confirmed. All access points are secured. The transport team will begin staging at 08:30. I’ll send a follow-up alert when the tankers arrive.

snapshot.instructorNote: Security confirms the emergency contact list (Annex A) was followed; the IC must approve the prioritization of hospital and dialysis centers for bottled water and tankers. The WQ Manager must confirm lab results will be used to validate the advisory lift.
